adminCannotDisable: The built-in administrator role cannot be disabled
builtinCannotDelete: Administrator and normal user are built-in roles and cannot be deleted
defaultRoleCannotDelete: Choose another default registration role before deleting this role
defaultRoleCannotDisable: Choose another default registration role before disabling this role
deleteDescription: Delete role “{0}”? Its menu permission assignments will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
permissionTemplateApplied: Filled {0} permissions and copied QPS plus minute/hour/day/month quotas from the template
permissionTemplateHelp: Available only when creating a role. Selecting a template copies that role's current effective menu and action permissions together with its QPS and minute/hour/day/month quotas; you can still adjust them afterwards.
permissionTemplatePlaceholder: Select an existing role to fill permissions and quota
permissionTemplateUnavailable: The selected role template no longer exists. Choose another one.
qpsHelp: Interfaces configured with QPS 0 use this quota. Active packages may only raise it.
quotaCountModeHelp: Count failures too: a request consumes free allowance as soon as it passes the admission gate, even if the upstream fails. Count successes only: only successfully returned calls consume free allowance.
quotaEnabledHelp: When on, this role is limited by the minute/hour/day/month caps. These caps are the free allowance bundled with the role. Once the free allowance is used up, users with an active package, points or balance keep calling on their paid quota instead of being blocked; the two layers are counted separately. When off, there is no total limit.
quotaZeroHelp: 0 disables that window. When both are set, minute ≤ hour ≤ day ≤ month must hold.
selfRegisterHelp: Only enabled non-admin roles with public registration enabled appear on the registration page.
statusConfirmDescription: Change role “{0}” to “{1}”? A disabled role no longer grants permissions.
superAdminPermissionsDescription: The administrator automatically receives every enabled administrator menu and action permission. This system policy cannot be reduced here.
